# RadarIQ

> RadarIQ helps Etsy sellers grade, optimize, and improve their listings using AI-powered insights — connect your shop and start improving today.

RadarIQ is an AI-powered SaaS that scores Etsy listings on title, tags, description, photos, and materials, then suggests selective or full optimizations sellers can review, edit, and push back to Etsy.

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, and waitlist signup.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How RadarIQ handles user and shop data.
